name: IronPhantom Antifraud
author: izioh1979

sections.description:
IronPhantom Antifraud connects WooCommerce to the IronPhantom / MGFirewallAI SaaS to analyze risk signals and flag potentially fraudulent orders and logins.
This plugin works only with an API key and does not alter WooCommerce/Core files.

Key features
– Opt-in only: no data is sent unless you enable it in settings.
– Real-time antifraud checks at checkout and right after login.
– Safe logging (no PII stored in options).
– Clean uninstall (removes its options and meta keys).
– HPOS compatibility (WooCommerce Custom Order Tables).

Privacy

This plugin connects your store to the IronPhantom / MGFirewallAI SaaS to perform fraud analysis.

Opt-in only. No data is sent unless you explicitly enable the option in WooCommerce settings.

What is sent (only when opt-in is enabled):
– Billing email (order)
– Public IP address of the customer
– Order ID and order total
– Timestamp (server local time)
– Login flow only: current URL right after login
– Technical metadata strictly required for fraud analysis (e.g., user agent)
– Optional “fingerprint” field (currently a placeholder)

Never sent: passwords, payment card numbers.

Endpoints used:
– POST https://redflagai.tech/api/predict (checkout)
– POST https://redflagai.tech/api/verify-login (after login)

HTTP headers: JSON content type; x-api-key for /api/predict.

Stored locally by the plugin:
– On the order: ironphantom_tx_id, ironphantom_risk_level, ironphantom_motivi, ironphantom_sent
– On the user (temporary flag to run once after login): ironphantom_appena_loggato

Uninstall: removing the plugin deletes its options and the above meta keys.

More information:
– Privacy Policy: https://redflagai.tech/privacy-policy
– Terms: https://redflagai.tech/terms
– Contact (email): security@redflagai.tech

You can stop all transfers at any time by disabling the consent checkbox in the plugin settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate (WooCommerce required).
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → General → “IronPhantom Antifraud”.
  3. Tick “Enable data sending (consent)” and paste your API key.
    Don’t have a key yet? Keys are issued by MGFirewallAI (IronPhantom). Request one via email: security@redflagai.tech
  4. (Optional) Enable diagnostic logs while testing.
  5. Place a test order or log in to see antifraud checks in action.
sections.faq:
Does it block the checkout?

No. It records antifraud results (and shows them to the merchant) but does not block Core WooCommerce flows.

How do I get an API key?

API keys are issued by MGFirewallAI (IronPhantom).
Email: security@redflagai.tech
Note: For plugin usage issues, please use the WordPress.org support forum on this plugin’s page. For key provisioning/billing, use the email above.

What happens if the API is unreachable?

The checkout continues. A safe diagnostic note is stored in admin (IronPhantom: Last HTTP response).

What gets logged?

If diagnostic logs are enabled, technical events are recorded with masked email/IP. It’s recommended to keep logs off in production.

How do I remove it completely?

Deactivate and delete the plugin. Its options and meta keys are removed on uninstall.
